error.conflict: Configuration changed. Refresh and apply your changes again.

federation.title: Federation
federation.subtitle: Manage this Station's Federation membership and governance.
federation.leaveHint: This Station will lose access to the Federation. The sequencer must hand over before leaving.
federation.deleteHint: The Federation will be archived through its governance ledger.

ai.title: AI Providers
ai.subtitle: Connect a model service and share it with your users.
ai.afterInstall: CLI installed. Continue configuring this Provider below. Installation does not verify authentication or model access.
ai.accountConnectionUnavailable: This adapter requires an account login. Dashboard account connection is not implemented yet; installation or model discovery does not make it usable.
ai.userPolicyHint: Global access and Provider model grants must both allow the user. Removing a user denies their next call.
ai.noUsersAllowed: Empty list: no user can use AI.
ai.usersUnavailable: Users could not be loaded. Search again to retry.
ai.lifecycle: Configure connection → Confirm models → Authorize users → Verify call → Use in Desktop.
ai.verifyHint: Choose an authorized user and model to send a short request without tools through the production path. Vendor usage may apply.
ai.verifyPassed: A real model response was received. This call passed.
ai.desktopConsumption: Authorized users choose their default model in Desktop → Settings → AI → Models, then select it in an Agent conversation and send a message.
ai.installHint: Install once on this Station. Each user runs with private configuration and caches.
ai.installRecovery: Retry installation or use the official guide.
ai.invalidRuntime: Enter one argument per line and environment as KEY=VALUE with unique variable names.
ai.responsesSourceHint: Choose an existing connection supporting OpenAI Responses. Verify a call before sharing.
ai.anthropicSourceHint: Choose an existing Anthropic Messages connection. Its key stays on the Station.
ai.sourceGrantHint: Users need access to both this profile and its model connection.
ai.removeKeyBeforeSource: Remove this profile's credential before choosing a shared connection.
ai.configurationChanged: This configuration changed. Your draft is retained; reload the latest version before saving.
ai.startupHint: One argv element per line, without shell quoting. Model, credentials and configuration paths cannot be overridden.
ai.environmentHint: One KEY=VALUE per line. Credentials, private directories and process loader options cannot be overridden.
ai.credentialStored: A credential is stored. Enter a new key to replace it.
ai.credentialHint: Keys are encrypted on this Station and cannot be read back.
ai.removeCredentialHint: Authorized users will lose access until a new credential is configured.
ai.deleteHint: Its models, credentials and grants will also be removed.
ai.invalidGrant: Select a model and enter an actor PTID for each specific grant.
ai.accessHint: Each grant authorizes a user and a model. An empty list denies access to everyone.
ai.configureBeforeGrant: Save this Provider's configuration before granting access.
ai.noCliModels: No models available. Install this Provider's CLI, configure account credentials, then discover models.
ai.noModels: No models are available. Add a model to configure this Provider.
ai.contextWindowHint: Enter the model's supported context size in tokens.
ai.invalidContextWindow: Enter a whole number between 2 and 10,000,000 tokens.
ai.personalHint: Users can manage their own credentials when enabled. Shared Providers retain priority.
ai.invalidId: Use lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens or underscores.
